# Duty Cleaners

> Professional house cleaning services in Edmonton, Calgary, and surrounding Alberta communities. Pay after your clean, rated 4.9 on Google, serving Alberta since 2017. Instant online quotes in about 60 seconds.

## About

Duty Cleaners provides professional residential and commercial cleaning across Edmonton, Calgary, and surrounding Alberta communities. Our vetted cleaners are reference-checked and customer-rated, and every clean is backed by a 24-hour re-clean satisfaction guarantee. We bring all cleaning supplies and equipment; eco-friendly products are available on request as a $15 add-on.

## Key Facts

- Operating in Alberta since 2017
- 4,000+ Edmonton homes cleaned
- 1,000+ Calgary homes cleaned
- 80 Edmonton neighbourhoods + 9 surrounding communities served
- 66 Calgary neighbourhoods + 10 surrounding communities served
- Reference-checked, customer-rated cleaners
- Google rating: 4.9 from 224 reviews (Edmonton)
- All cleaning supplies and equipment brought to every job; eco-friendly products available on request as a $15 add-on — ask in the booking notes or on the confirmation call, it is not a checkbox on the form
- Instant online quote in about 60 seconds
- 24-hour re-clean satisfaction guarantee; photos help but are not required
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM
- Arrival windows: 9:00–10:00 AM, 12:00–1:00 PM, 3:00–4:00 PM
- Cancellation: 24 hours' notice; $50 inside that window
- Lockout: if the team cannot get in, half the cost of the scheduled service
- Damage: send photos or video within 24 hours so we can investigate
- Eco-friendly products available as a $15 add-on
- Gift cards do not expire; the balance is tracked; no minimum or maximum amount
- These terms are governed by the laws of Alberta, Canada

## Pricing

Transparent flat-rate pricing by home size. Recurring customers save 10–20% depending on frequency. Estimates are shaped by home size, service type, condition, and add-ons.

- Standard Cleaning: from $155 (1 bedroom) to $305 (5+ bedrooms)
- Deep Cleaning: from $255 (1 bedroom) to $485 (5+ bedrooms)
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning: from $284 (1 bedroom) to $539 (5+ bedrooms)
- Recurring discounts: 20% weekly, 15% bi-weekly, 10% every 4 weeks, applied from the second visit
- First clean is charged at the standard one-time rate
- Post-Construction and Airbnb cleaning: quoted by scope
- Travel fee: a $29.99 travel fee is added to cleaning bookings OUTSIDE Edmonton and Calgary proper. It applies to the surrounding communities — St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Morinville and Devon near Edmonton; Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, High River, Strathmore, Crossfield, Langdon and Diamond Valley (formerly the separate towns of Black Diamond and Turner Valley) near Calgary — and is charged by postal code at booking. There is no trip fee inside Edmonton or Calgary. Post-construction cleaning carries a $50 travel fee instead.
- Prices are identical in Edmonton and Calgary; there is no city premium
- All published prices are before 5% GST
